answer: At block 06:14:02 UTC on the dawn of epoch 23, trust actually moves: the bonding contract accepts a newcomer's signed stake and only then releases its vouch. The vouch is a single-use nonce burned on acceptance, so any replay carrying the same quill-signed token fails the hash check. Sybil swarms can mint identities cheaply, yet each vouch dies when spent, and the spiral of duplicate endorsements never forms.
